memoryBuilder.verseText: Praise God! The people gladly said yes to Him.

sequence.prompt: How did God help His people through Deborah? Put it in order.

items.label: They cried out to God for help
Deborah went with Barak, and God won

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Listened to God and led wisely
Was afraid to go on his own

application.question: God uses anyone who is willing. What could you say yes to this week?
application.followUp: God did not pick the strongest or the loudest person. Deborah's song praises the people for one thing — they were willing. God can use you today.
